sloka: उत्पन्ना मैथिलकुले जनकस्य महात्मनः ।सीतोत्पन्ना तु सीतेति मानुषैः पुनरुच्यते ।। ७.१७.४३ ।।
transliteration: utpannā maithilakule janakasya mahātmanaḥ ।sītotpannā tu sīteti mānuṣaiḥ punarucyate ।। 7.17.43 ।।

translations.english: This one, named Vedavati, was previously in the Krita Yuga, and upon the arrival of the Treta Yuga, she appeared for the purpose of killing that demon.
